newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's tourism continues sliding downhill.
newsitem.headline: Austria's tourism continues sliding downhill.

text.p: Austria's crumbling tourism industry, once the backbone of the Alpine republic's economy, suffered a fresh blow on Tuesday when the economics ministry confirmed fears that the downhill trend was not bottoming out.
According to preliminary figures, the ministry said revenue from the summer season fell four percent and that overnight stays during the May to October period slumped 5.7 percent.
For 1996 as a whole, the ministry expects Austria's tourism to suffer a decline in income of around four to five percent, and does not see the industry recovering until 1998.
